'''Operation Katabatic''' was a series of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strikes on critical [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] bases during the [[Battle of Atraken]]. This push led to the defeat of the Separatist forces; however, the battle left the [[Planet/Legends|world]] a desolate wasteland.
